title: Last quality: 4x4min uphill treadmill
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 4x4min at 10-12% incline, 158-169 bpm, 2min walking recovery at 5% between. Warmup 15min minimum, non-negotiable. Last hard session before the race.
GYM: none. Legs are for Saturday.
FUEL: 1 gel 20min before, water during.
STOP RULE: no symptoms during, after, or next day. If rep 1 or 2 produces lateral knee pain, stop the session - do not test rep 3.
WHY IT IS UPHILL: steep uphill keeps the knee largely outside the 20-30 degree flexion band where the band compresses the lateral epicondyle, has no eccentric braking phase, and transfers directly to 1900m of continuous ascent off the gun at Pirin. Cut from 5x5min on 27 Aug to 4x4min because at 9 days out this is a sharpener, not a stimulus - there is no fitness left to acquire and everything to protect.
